pages.text:
Wireframe Description: Home Page
Desktop and mobile layouts include the Björk heading, shared navigation, artist photograph, general information, and a placeholder for the “Venus as a Boy” music video.

Wireframe Description: History Page
Desktop and mobile layouts combine the shared navigation, a portrait, and artist history. The mobile view stacks the page content in a single column.

Wireframe Description: Discography Page
Desktop and mobile layouts show the shared navigation, discography text, and an album artwork grid with album labels.

Wireframe Description: Influences Page
Desktop and mobile layouts pair written content with photographs and an album-cover placeholder beneath the shared navigation.

Wireframe Description: References Page
The desktop layout presents source references in two columns. The mobile layout stacks the references beneath the shared navigation.
